description: Taskaid AI helps users manage private tasks, task lists, and daily plans from ChatGPT. It can find active tasks and lists, create or update tasks and task lists, and read or replace the daily plan shown in Taskaid.

defaultPrompt: Review my active tasks and help me decide what deserves attention today.
Create a focused daily plan from my current tasks.
Review my task lists and help me re-organize anything that is in the wrong place.
